newsitem.title: ECUADOR: At least two Ecuador protesters injured by gunshots.
newsitem.headline: At least two Ecuador protesters injured by gunshots.

text.p: At least two people were injured by gunshots on Thursday during a protest outside Congress by 4,000 demonstrators who were calling on legislators to dismiss President Abdala Bucaram, radio reports said.
An unknown number of the protesters, angered by the gunfire, threw rocks and gasoline bombs at security forces guarding Congress doors.
After police responded with teargas, the protest quickly dissipated, Radio Quito reported.

A Congress spokesman identified one of those injured as a spokesman for a political party, the Popular Democratic Movement. The other, according to Radio Quito, was a photographer for a local newspaper.
The demonstration came before Congress was to hold an extraordinary session in which opponents of Bucaram were expected to debate his possible dismissal.
